caption: Steam rises from a kettle spout in a sunlit kitchen, and a faint, shifting shadow of the plume drifts on the wall behind it.

sa.check: Steam rises from a kettle spout.
A shadow of the plume drifts on the wall behind it.
The shadow is faint and shifting.

pc.expect: The shadow is on the side of the plume away from the window and moves and thins as the steam does.
pc.fail: It is on the sunlit side; or stays still while the steam moves; or it is as dark as the kettle's shadow.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only as the steam moves.
pc.fail: It drifts with the steam still; or moves before the plume; or lingers after the steam has gone.
It sinks; or hangs; or flows sideways with no draught.

pc.expect: The shadow is a soft shifting wisp like the plume.
pc.fail: It is a hard-edged shape; or splits into unrelated pieces; or is a solid block.
A second kettle appears; or the plume comes from nowhere; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The kettle and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The kettle changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.
